notes.title: Wiarton Willie Predicts an Early Spring! (free download)
notes.content:
[h3]On February 2nd, 2025, the infamous groundhog, Wiarton Willie, did not see his shadow, meaning there will be an early spring! Did you know that Wiarton Willie, in the game "A Beaver's Tale", is based on a real ground hog?[/h3]

To celebrate the good news, the game will be [u][b]free to download for a week! (Ending Feb. 7th)[/b][/u]

Simply download the "demo" on the Steam page. It's released as the full game. Enjoy!

[i]Wiarton Willie[/i] is the name of a Canadian groundhog who lives in the community of Wiarton in Bruce County, Ontario. Every February 2, on Groundhog Day, Willie takes part in the local Wiarton Willie Festival. His role is to predict whether there will be an early spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/971a588edebadb8d62a8ef27ab05c53d16d283fb.jpg[/img]

(photo by Kevin M Klerks from Inverhuron, Canada)

notes.title: Buckey got an engine upgrade!! Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I have worked hard to get some new updates and important bug fixes for [i]A Beaver's Tale[/i]. Some folks who speed run the game, and some others who play tested brought these issues to my attention, so thank you kindly! [i]A Beaver's Tale[/i] is better because of you :)

Here is the list of improvements in version 1.1:
[list]
[*] The game has been upgraded to the newest, stable Godot engine version (4.3).
[*] FXAA anti-aliasing is now enabled for the game, removing some of the jagged edges.
[*] The various bugs involving saving have been fixed. This includes the "Delete Save Data" button which allows you to make a new game anywhere inside A Beaver's Tale (nice for speed runners!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/2c92935c77eee11e33664fdbf9938eb5e5b24c19.png[/img]
[*] There's a new loading screen now between the various game modes - this makes the transition much smoother.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/1f07abe0def336a21423d82b54b35870466b16d3.png[/img]
[*] Buckey's movement speed has been fixed. He used to move slowly vertically, but really fast horizontally.
[*] Fishing has been fixed. There were some edge cases where fishes were de-spawning, making it really hard to get the fishing achievement.
[*] Bugs involving logs and the final cut scene have been fixed.
[*] Terrain flattening has been removed from build mode, since it seems people weren't using it, and it causes issues with the grass "disconnecting".
[*] An issue that occurred sometimes when the game closed has been fixed. This is one of the main reasons performance has really improved!
[/list]

Thanks for hanging in there, and I hope you enjoy the updates!

Michael

notes.title: You can now catch fish! (Responsibly)
notes.content:
I've got another tiny update for you that packs in a few new changes. First of all, you can now go "fishing"! Well, not really. Buckey is a herbivore, so he's more into catch and release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/b057847aa5f5dbbe56a4f7b41295f2789c2ff0cd.gif[/img]

There's also a shiny new achievement for fishing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/924e74dc014cff29b7ef4c9a4a1bdc7eb9aeb51d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/e10cc8879313072cd3f66d2c1ebd1e59204be6ef.png[/img]

Some other small things in version 1.0.2:
- Small bug fix with switching windows while game is running
- Bug fix when multiple prompts are triggered. Before, the prompt in the top right corner would just overwrite the previous one, and you could miss information. Now they are "queued" so if you trigger another one, it will just play after the current one is done

-Michael

notes.title: First Quality of Life Patch! Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I have released the first update for A Beaver's Tale!

It uses "semantic versioning", meaning this patch will not break any existing game installs that are out there.

A few nice quality of life updates:
[list]
[*]You can now dynamically change what monitor the game is playing on [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/1bc409e1bf578aa250b408f776b3a34899e907ca.png[/img]
[*] There are a number of new prompts that are added to help gameplay. Not all of it was clear
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/4586640be0d73e86234b84ea04187d5dbc034126.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/c3a4427da42e44fd9b04ef81b4eb4226403c87ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064524/5201ce7f044eb8e6cf64869f242237a72e1aee0a.png[/img]
[/list]

Thanks for playing and I hope this patch makes the play experience a little better!

-Michael
